title: bladhia crenata
intro: Bladhia crenata, commonly known as Indian Pennywort, is a type of herb that belongs to the family Urticaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Bladhia crenata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which help in protecting against oxidative stress and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
